note: Rough search-area estimate from archived actual street, railway and waterway geometry and cited public descriptions. Manual links between named anchors are analyst inference; this is not an official or surveyed neighborhood boundary. Historical and overlapping subdivisions are retained separately.

areas.name: Margit-negyed
areas.note: Approximate centerline trace of the full street loop in the II district decree. The decree additionally includes both sides of selected perimeter streets; this coarse polygon does not reconstruct those individual property extensions.

areas.name: Európa lakókert
areas.note: The developer and contemporary press locate the project in the block enclosed by these four streets. The archived OSM name point lies just east of Vágás utca and outside this historical street loop; it is retained as evidence of that mismatch, not used to expand the source-defined block.

areas.name: Honfoglalás lakópark
areas.note: Historical estate extent estimated around the nine named streets reported by the municipal newspaper. Its eastern part overlaps the later separately named Csabaliget development; no alias or disjoint administrative partition is asserted.

areas.name: Csabaliget
areas.note: Manual ring around the compact apartment/small-street development east of Etelköz and south of Budapesti út, using its saved access-road fabric and railway edge. The cited Center parcel supports the neighborhood location but is not substituted for the entire estate boundary.

areas.name: Malomdomb
areas.note: Broad residential subarea inferred from the Malomdomb street/address evidence and the continuous saved Malom street network. Transitions to adjacent Európa and Honfoglalás developments are approximate and may overlap.

areas.name: Ilonatelep
areas.note: Historical housing area south of Szabadföld út and east of Gazdaság út, extending toward the cemetery. Southern transition around the visible housing streets is an analyst estimate; no surveyed cemetery/property boundary is claimed.

areas.name: Újtelep
areas.note: Manual estimate around the named Újtelep residential street fabric between the Caprera-patak corridor, Magtár/Gazdaság road axis and Szabadföld/HÉV. The broad generic historical name is not equated with another Újtelep elsewhere in Budapest.

areas.name: Kisszentmihály
areas.note: Historical boundary convention from the 2013 district history article: Rákospalotai határút / district boundary / Timur utca / Szlovák út. The article also discusses a later proposed Timur-to-Csömöri boundary change. Adopted extent is the historical alternative, not an alias for all Árpádföld. The saved district boundary supplies the northern cadastral edge; its short NW portion follows Rákospalotai határút. Derivation: Polygonize union of saved named road/stream lines and frozen native XVI district boundary, select existing name point only to identify the source-bounded cell, simplify 0.000025 degree. The point does not create the boundary.

areas.name: Szent György-telep
areas.note: Historical four-side extent from district history: Rákospalotai határút / Szilas-patak / Csömöri út / János utca. Exact frozen road and stream intersections form the ring; the district boundary follows Rákospalotai határút on its NW side. Street-centerline and watercourse convention is an estimated search area, not a parcel boundary. Derivation: Polygonize union of saved named road/stream lines and frozen native XVI district boundary, select existing name point only to identify the source-bounded cell, simplify 0.000025 degree. The point does not create the boundary.

areas.name: Óhegyi lakótelep
areas.note: Estimated estate envelope anchored to official street membership in X district regulation 12/2013 Annex2 G. Follows Petrőczy and Kada to Harmat, then the ends of Csombor and Sorház; the eastern link from Sorház to the eastern Noszlopy loop is a manual approximate estate edge. Noszlopy and Petrőczy form the south edge. This includes all named official estate streets; it is broader than the smaller four-road core and intentionally estimated. No parcel precision is claimed. Derivation: Manual WGS84 road-intersection/end-point ring, including approximate eastern connector; all anchors checked against frozen southeast road geometry.

areas.name: EcoLiget lakópark
anchors: Alsóhatár utca 5 estate private driveways, OSM ways743704119/743704120
Eastern private estate footway, OSM way648297931
areas.note: Estimated actual estate circulation envelope at officially identified Alsóhatár utca5 / project parcel1151/5. Northern edge follows private entrance driveway; eastern and southern edges follow private estate paths; western edge follows the Alsóhatár frontage sidewalk. A short eastern gap between driveway end and private path is joined manually. This is a small circulation-derived approximation within the estate, not a claim to reproduce parcel1151/5. No outline was inferred from the name point. Derivation: Manual ring from frozen actual private driveway/path vertices, including short connector.

areas.name: Budagyöngye
areas.note: Informal locality around the historic Házmán/Pázsit–Szilágyi Erzsébet corner and present shopping center. The surrounding road intersections give a rough neighborhood envelope; no official Budagyöngye perimeter is claimed.

areas.name: Szabadságtelep
areas.note: Manual residential-street envelope around the named HÉV locality. BKK identifies the Szabadságtelep replacement stop near Bekecs/Ábra and the Timur–Csöbör approach; these support locality identification, not a complete estate perimeter. Eastern transition and overlap with Árpádföld are approximate.

areas.name: Kakukkhegy
areas.note: XXII district Kakukkhegy locality (not the similarly named Budaörs hill). Named Magaslati/Iglice/upper Csúcs street fabric is enclosed approximately by the visible Balatoni/Dózsa main-road edge and Fennsík/Kunyhó cross streets. The western hillside transition is inferred.

areas.name: Felsőváros
areas.note: Budafok-Felsőváros garden-city extent estimated around the Gádor street corridor and its documented upper-town streets. The municipal character regulation separately names Felsőváros; this trace uses its saved surrounding roads and does not claim to digitize the regulation map or equal all Budafok.

areas.name: Csillebérci Üdülőtelep
areas.note: Manual outline of the distinct dense private-path/holiday-house street cluster around Sugár út and Csillebérc utca. Historical association and local notices establish the estate location. Peripheral path and forest transitions are approximate; this is not the whole native Csillebérc parent or the youth camp.

areas.name: Szilasmenti TSz
areas.note: Small former-cooperative/industrial compound envelope south of Vidámvásár and east of Csobogó, traced from its actual circulation road fabric. The cooperative history supports identity; no claim is made to map all historical agricultural land holdings or all places bearing the Szilasmenti name.

areas.name: Nagyvásártelep
anchors: Ujgur mártírok útja (formerly Helyi kikötő út)
areas.note: Historical market-depot area estimated between the two source-named boundary streets and visible eastern rail/depot edge. Dalai láma road vertices are preserved as anchors; the northeastern and terminal connectors are approximate. No current redevelopment-site parcel precision is claimed.

areas.name: Palotai-sziget
areas.note: Former-island riverfront area traced approximately between the legally described Rév/Duna sor/Zsilip/rail-bridge anchors and saved riverside path fabric. The cited nature-reserve footprint supplies geographic context, but this estimated historical locality is not certified to equal the reserve's exact 478297 m² cadastral boundary; shoreline and northern tip are approximate.

areas.name: Megyeri Hídfő
areas.note: Approximate southern bridgehead subarea using Váci út, the M0 bridge approach and stream/Óceán-árok corridor. Public plans define the larger combined Székesdűlő-and-Megyeri-Hídfő planning unit; this ring selects the bridgehead portion and does not equate the entire combined parent with this child name.

areas.name: Farkashegy
areas.note: Soroksár Farkashegy locality beside the western BILK rail-terminal margin, not the identically named Buda hills. Manual envelope follows saved residential and peripheral access streets; northern overlap/transition to Millenniumtelep and southern field-road limits are approximate. The reporting source supports the location beside the terminal, not an exact perimeter.

areas.name: Szent László-telep
areas.note: Estimated public-map street-group extent containing documented Agyagos, Pestvidéki, Kisvárda, Füzesabony, Nápoly, Szabadság sugárút and Derkovits tér streets. The enclosing Tápióbicske, Öntöző, Lemberg and Pesti roads are a coarse interpretation of the saved street fabric, not published official limits. Historical and everyday estate extents may be smaller or overlap adjacent Rákoscsaba subdivisions. Derivation: Interpret enclosing source roads around independently documented street group; polygonize actual saved OSM lines, select the source-bounded cell using name point, simplify0.000025degree. No point buffer or synthetic rectangle.

areas.name: Virágtelep
areas.note: Broad estimated public-map street-group extent east of Lemberg and west of Zrínyi, south of Csabagyöngye and north of Pesti. Public street maps associate Körömvirág, Méhecske, Százdi, Kalmárvölgy and Tanár with Virágtelep; independent reporting identifies the Fátyolvirág/Tubarózsa/Körömvirág cluster. The 2022 planning assessment places the distinctive paired-house estate within this larger four-road sector. Its exact 1980s development footprint is smaller and was not recovered; this approximate search area includes neighboring street blocks. Derivation: Interpret enclosing source roads around independently documented street group; polygonize actual saved OSM lines, select the source-bounded cell using name point, simplify0.000025degree. No point buffer or synthetic rectangle.

areas.name: Királyhágó lakópark
areas.note: Estimated road-bounded envelope of the 2000s Királyhágó street-front estate, using Kétújfalu, Kappel Emília, Halomi and Királyhágó. The district museum distinguishes this former sports-field frontage from the later development toward Tarkő/Kétújfalu centered on Herrich Károly tér, which is outside this ring. Developer reference confirms Királyhágó4 at81. Internal named phases and adjacent branded estates retain distinct identities; no alias or precise parcel boundary is asserted. Derivation: Interpret enclosing source roads around independently documented street group; polygonize actual saved OSM lines, select the source-bounded cell using name point, simplify0.000025degree. No point buffer or synthetic rectangle.

areas.name: Nagyiccetelep
areas.note: Historical Nagyicce-telep limits explicitly listed by the XVI district official newspaper, page14: Veres Péter, Sárgarózsa, Pesti határút, Lobbanó, Hősök fasora. The frozen named roads form one closed ring. The current point label is farther east and is deliberately not forced into this historical outline; district historian separately warns that Nagyicce labels have been misplaced toward the Mátyásföld airport. Historical subdivision overlap is intentional. Road-centerline convention is estimated, not cadastral precision. Derivation: Polygonize union of actual frozen named-road lines from all four saved sectors; exactly one bounded polygon. Simplify0.000025degree; no use of point for geometry or selection.

areas.name: Szárazhegy
areas.note: Broad, inferred Szárazhegy residential locality envelope from actual street fabric: Nagyszentmiklósi at northwest, a short Szigetcsép/Barnabás step to Szárazhegy út at north, Szárazhegy/Ököl at east, Pesti at south and Zrínyi at west. This is an intentionally approximate search-area convention around the existing hillside streets; the northwest and western limits are inferred transitions with neighboring Rákoscsaba subdivisions. Public planning sources verify Szárazhegy locality/development around these roads but do not define this entire perimeter. Includes the older streets southwest of Szigetcsép as well as the developed northeastern strip; does not equate the whole neighborhood with Panoráma first phase or the proposed expansion parcel. No official whole-quarter boundary is claimed. Derivation: Manual ring following saved named-road vertices and selected road junctions. Long Pesti segment represented with coarse source-road anchors. Scope inferred from locality text and actual street-group fabric; no radius, point dimensions or synthetic rectangle.
